body:
I followed your suggestion @bobylito -> we only have items now. I also added a boolean `isFromSearch` to know if a searchForFacetsValues has been performed or not. 

The next step about this PR are:
* should we keep the facetQuery in our `searchState` (also see my previous comment on that)?
* Should we merge both `searchResults` and `searchForFacetValuesResults`?
* Once #1765 is merged, refactor code responsible to call the helper for SFFV
* Fix the naming once the API is stable
* Add the jsdoc & guide
* Add this feature into one of our example?
